## Biography & Entity Description
Baman Prasad Guragain (known online as MrTrotid) is a cybersecurity practitioner, software developer, and undergraduate Computer Science student at Kathmandu University, Nepal. He completed Cambridge International A-Levels at St. Xavier's College, Maitighar, achieving distinction grades in Mathematics (A) and Computer Science (A). His technical focus spans network security, Linux systems administration (Debian and Arch Linux), Python software development, web security, and modern cloud deployment.

## Technical Skills & Systems
- Programming Languages: Python (Intermediate), JavaScript / TypeScript, C / C++ (Foundational), Bash / Shell scripting, SQL
- Security & Networking: Cisco Networking Fundamentals, Firewall architectures, Web Application Security, Network Packet Analysis, Incident Response basics
- Tools & Cloud: Linux (Debian, Arch Linux, Kali Linux), Docker, Git & GitHub Version Control, AWS Cloud (EC2, S3, IAM)
- Web & Frontend: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, GSAP 3, Framer Motion 12, Lenis smooth scrolling

## Featured Projects
1. AQ Sentinel (2025)
   - Scope: Real-time IoT air quality monitoring platform designed to eliminate reliance on expensive proprietary hardware.
   - Technology: ESP32 microcontroller, custom telemetry pipeline, React/Node.js web application.
   - Outcome: 1st Place Winner at the St. Xavier's College intra-college STEAM exhibition; real-time visualization of environmental telemetry.
   - Case Study: https://projects.bamanguragain.com.np/aq-sentinel

2. MeroAushadhi (2025)
   - Scope: Medicine information and clinical availability tracking application addressing health literacy barriers for Nepali-speaking users.
   - Technology: Google Generative AI, Flowise, Supabase, React.
   - Outcome: 3rd Place Award and Best UI/UX Award at Cambridge Code League A-Levels hackathon.
   - Case Study: https://projects.bamanguragain.com.np/meroaushadhi

3. A-Level Past Paper Extractor (2024)
   - Scope: Python desktop automation utility streamlining Cambridge International examination preparation.
   - Technology: Python, Tkinter, CustomTkinter, Requests, Pillow.
   - Outcome: Automated downloading, year-by-year filtering (2021-2024), and structured local directory organization of exam past papers.
   - Case Study: https://projects.bamanguragain.com.np/question-paper-extractor
